expected: BS-P1-020 must make DO_NOT_PERSIST input lifecycle implementable across POST /intents and POST /intents/{id}/compile without persisting protected values or requiring implementation to invent transport/re-provision semantics.
actual: Independent BCE audit of PR #290 confirmed the locked design requires request-scoped EphemeralResolvedContext for Prompt B and User re-provision on retry, but the compile request contract does not define the field, shape, binding, validation, or idempotency behavior for supplying those values. PR #290 therefore selected a narrower behavior that rejects referenced DO_NOT_PERSIST inputs before Prompt B. A separate FAILED_TERMINAL replay defect remains implementation remediation and does not widen this Design delta.

BS-P1-020 F01 compile API does not define a bounded request field/schema for those re-provided values.
